purpose: Source-only expansion of r47 from 3 pilots/23 requests/43 checkpoints to all 12 original natural replay declarations/110 requests/210 checkpoints. No new replay, rule, or runtime authorization.

validation.executed_in_this_phase: Cross-object structural and typed-proposal construction only

sequence_constraints: Each replay starts a separate original new room/opening even if worlds reused; DS01/DS02 is one continuous replay.
Within each formal turn, all original pre_main_requests in declared order before normal_main.
Two refusals on DS01/02 R4 are separate semantic attempts under unchanged unsafe state, not transport retries.
Hero and mutation tuple binds after real RPS, using the true player/side assignment; initial source witness is not runtime secret identity injection.
Matched-pair semantics come from original sources and require independent source/authority proof; the table alone cannot create a paired observed comparison.

api_boundary.typed_only: MoveCommand and HeroAbilityCommand mapping proposals, not accepted wire payloads. Source stored 'UNRESOLVED_NOT_AN_API_SCHEMA' for normal main.
api_boundary.actor_binding: trusted room/game.players from actual RPS; do not infer playerId from semantic actor side
api_boundary.revision_action: current authority revision and driver unique actionId, never static placeholder submission
api_boundary.caster: bomb pieceId must be visible and actually controlled at that moment, never authority_only_expected_caster_initial_id copied into player payload
api_boundary.observer: actual return can include normal close/tick; cannot be advertised as after-full-main-atom checkpoint
api_boundary.secret: trusted authority-only initial IDs do not become client information

world_randomness: 10 source identity worlds each contain 28 black then red 15-piece Fisher–Yates draw declarations; mutation draw/legal setup remains main-owned and UNRUN.
